spans.s:
mfn. subst. (-टः-टा-टं)
The expanded hood or neck of the Cobra de capello.
mf. (-टः-टा)
1 A tooth.
2 A cheat.
E.
स्फुट to burst or expand, aff. अच्, fem. aff. टाप्, deriv. irr.

ind.
Exclamation of no meaning, forming part of a Mantra or incantation.
E.
स्फुट to burst, aff. क्विप् and the deriv. irr.
